Mapping these bulk gene signatures onto scRNA-seq data uncovered their underlying cellular diversity, with prominent expression of the protumorigenic inflammation signature by myeloid phagocytic cells.

Primary: the core association claim (2IR score correlating with clinical outcomes in urothelial cancer) is preserved but reframed in the published Conclusions section with different wording, renaming entities (inflammatory_response -> protumorigenic inflammation, monocytes/macrophages -> myeloid phagocytic cells) and adding a cellular-state elaboration, without changing direction, scope, or effect-type class, making this minor. S1: the same finding about low-score myeloid cells is preserved with entity renaming (monocytes/macrophages -> myeloid phagocytic cells, 2IR -> Msc2IR, IL1B -> proinflammatory cytokines/chemokines) but no direction, scope, or magnitude change, making this minor. S2: the cellular mapping finding is preserved but the published version omits the T/NK/B cell and fibroblast detail and focuses only on myeloid cells, representing a wording/framing change without a direction flip or scope change that crosses a major threshold, making this minor.
